thread:
ivy: Huge shoutout to @marcus and Facilities for bringing the ficus back from the brink this morning 
It looked like a dry-forest casualty at 8am and now it's basically thriving. botanical heroics! :seedling:
marcus: thanks! found the drainage clogged and gave it a proper drink + repotted a sad section. shoutout to @janet for babysitting the front desk while I wrestled with soil :muscle:
facilities: Teamwork. We swapped soil, tightened the planter frame, and left a small care tag with watering cadence. No charge 
Also pro tip: coffee grounds mix helps slow-release nutrients :wrench: :coffee:
janet: the lobby smells like fresh dirt and victory. also got a bunch of compliments from folks who thought we hired a florist :bouquet:
angelo: people-ops here 
We love this. Sending a little "Plant Rescuer" sticker pack and a $25 plant shop voucher to Marcus + Facilities. If anyone else chipped in, DM me and we'll add you to the thank-you note :mailbox_with_mail:
stickerbot: Sticker created: "Plant Rescuer". Awarded 1 sticker to marcus and 1 sticker to facilities. :sparkles:
securitybot: Noted: plant care logged in facilities calendar. Reminder set: "Lobby plant check" every Monday 09:00. (reminder created)
ivy: also huge thanks to @securitybot for flagging the water leak that stressed the plant in the first place 
small wins. :heart:
marcus: mini poll: should we build a tiny 'plant rescue kit' for the office? react with :one: for "basic" (soil + watering can), :two: for "pro" (soil + fertilizer + pruners), :three: for "deluxe" (all of the above + plant book)
janet: :two: from me. pruners = peace of mind.
facilities: we'll stash a kit in the maintenance closet and rotate supplies. love the idea 
Also happy to run a quick 15-min "plant CPR" session next week if people are into it :seedling:
people-ops: We'll include the Plant Rescuer shoutout in the monthly kudos email and add Marcus + Facilities to the rotating thank-you list. Thanks everyone for pitching in " :
